text.autoconfig.imprint.title: Imprint
text.autoconfig.imprint.option.tickInter: Base number of ticks between footprints.
text.autoconfig.imprint.option.speedThre: Minimum movement speed (in blocks/sec) required to spawn footprints.
text.autoconfig.imprint.option.footOffse: Distance from the player (in blocks) to spawn footprints.
text.autoconfig.imprint.option.footprint: Size of the footprint collision check.
text.autoconfig.imprint.option.showWhile: Whether to show footprints while crouching.
text.autoconfig.imprint.option.rainbowMo: Enables a rainbow effect that cycles through colors with each step.
text.autoconfig.imprint.option.showOther: Whether to show footprints for other players.
Whether to show footprints for mobs and other non-player entities.
text.autoconfig.imprint.option.enableDus: Enable dust/leaf particles when walking on certain blocks (sand, gravel, leaves, etc.).
